data.title: 能天使 · 苹果派出炉之后
data.description: 【能天使 · 苹果派出炉之后】烘焙间飘着苹果和肉桂的香气，穿着奶油色毛衣、百褶裙与苹果图案围裙的能天使站在操作台前。她戴好隔热手套，用双手把一盘刚出炉的苹果派稳稳放上冷却架，忍不住露出期待的笑容——「先等它凉一点！这次边缘烤得刚刚好！」
data.action: 戴着隔热手套，双手把烤盘放在台面的冷却架上
data.promptProse: At a bakery worktop, Exusiai wears her cream sweater and apple-print apron, using both oven-mitted hands to lower a fresh apple pie tray onto a wire cooling rack. Morning light through the flour-dusted window meets the warm oven glow, illuminating the browned pastry and her eager smile as the pie begins to cool.
data.camera: medium shot, worktop at waist height with tray and gloved hands visible
